claim: Path.iterdir raises NotADirectoryError when called on a file.
ground_truth_evidence: The commit changes Path.iterdir to raise NotADirectoryError when not self.is_dir().
task_description: Review zipp Path.iterdir behavior after commit 84be2a5.

claim: Path.iterdir still raises ValueError when called on a file.
ground_truth_evidence: The updated implementation raises NotADirectoryError, not ValueError.
task_description: Review zipp Path.iterdir behavior after commit 84be2a5.

claim: Translator.extend appends \z to the generated regex.
ground_truth_evidence: Translator.extend returns rf'(?s:{pattern})\z'.
task_description: Review zipp glob regex terminator after commit d860de4.

claim: Translator.extend still appends \Z to the generated regex.
ground_truth_evidence: The updated implementation and docstring use \z, not \Z.
task_description: Review zipp glob regex terminator after commit d860de4.

claim: Markup.striptags collapses whitespace after removing comments and tags.
ground_truth_evidence: The commit moves value = ' '.join(value.split()) to after the comment and tag removal loops.
task_description: Review MarkupSafe striptags whitespace handling after commit 0b6bee0.

claim: Markup.striptags collapses whitespace before removing comments and tags.
ground_truth_evidence: The updated implementation converts to str first, removes comments and tags, then collapses whitespace.
task_description: Review MarkupSafe striptags whitespace handling after commit 0b6bee0.

claim: Path._base uses pathlib.PurePath for the zipfile filename when self.at is empty.
ground_truth_evidence: The updated _base returns pathlib.PurePath(self.root.filename) in the else branch.
task_description: Review zipp Path._base after commit 3503c8b.

claim: Path._base always wraps self.root.filename with pathlib.PurePosixPath.
ground_truth_evidence: The updated _base only uses PurePosixPath for self.at; otherwise it uses PurePath.
task_description: Review zipp Path._base after commit 3503c8b.

claim: _ancestry treats multiple separators like a single path separator.
ground_truth_evidence: The updated docstring states multiple separators are treated like a single and the loop stops on path.endswith(posixpath.sep).
task_description: Review zipp malformed path ancestry after commit f89b93f.

claim: _ancestry still loops until path equals exactly posixpath.sep.
ground_truth_evidence: The updated loop condition is while path and not path.endswith(posixpath.sep).
task_description: Review zipp malformed path ancestry after commit f89b93f.

claim: Path.open checks zip_mode == 'r' before calling self.exists().
ground_truth_evidence: The updated condition is if zip_mode == 'r' and not self.exists().
task_description: Review zipp Path.open missing-file check after commit 71ddd8d.

claim: Path.open calls self.exists() before checking whether the zip mode is read mode.
ground_truth_evidence: The updated condition short-circuits on zip_mode == 'r' before self.exists().
task_description: Review zipp Path.open missing-file check after commit 71ddd8d.

claim: Translator.translate wraps translate_core with match_dirs.
ground_truth_evidence: translate returns self.extend(self.match_dirs(self.translate_core(pattern))).
task_description: Review zipp directory glob matching after commit 5d89a1c.

claim: Translator.translate returns self.extend(self.translate_core(pattern)) without match_dirs.
ground_truth_evidence: The updated translate call includes match_dirs around translate_core.
task_description: Review zipp directory glob matching after commit 5d89a1c.

claim: Path.is_symlink uses stat.S_ISLNK on mode derived from external_attr.
ground_truth_evidence: is_symlink reads info.external_attr >> 16 and returns stat.S_ISLNK(mode).
task_description: Review zipp Path.is_symlink after commit dc5fe8f.

claim: Path.is_symlink always returns False.
ground_truth_evidence: The updated implementation computes mode and calls stat.S_ISLNK(mode).
task_description: Review zipp Path.is_symlink after commit dc5fe8f.

claim: MarkupSafe compiles the strip-tags regexes with re.DOTALL.
ground_truth_evidence: _strip_comments_re and _strip_tags_re are compiled with re.DOTALL.
task_description: Review MarkupSafe striptags regex flags after commit e49d257.

claim: MarkupSafe strip-tags regexes do not match newlines.
ground_truth_evidence: The regexes use re.DOTALL so dot matches newlines.
task_description: Review MarkupSafe striptags regex flags after commit e49d257.

claim: Markup.__mod__ wraps a single non-mapping argument in a one-element tuple.
ground_truth_evidence: The else branch assigns arg = (_MarkupEscapeHelper(arg, self.escape),).
task_description: Review MarkupSafe percent-format single placeholder behavior after commit 3d809ae.

claim: Markup.__mod__ passes a single non-mapping argument directly to _MarkupEscapeHelper without tuple wrapping.
ground_truth_evidence: The updated else branch wraps the helper in a one-element tuple.
task_description: Review MarkupSafe percent-format single placeholder behavior after commit 3d809ae.
